title: HMS Hood's bell
status_note: Recovered from the wreck in 2015; rededicated in 2016.

place.label: National Museum of the Royal Navy, Portsmouth (pin approximate)

timeline.event: The bell first served in the earlier battleship Hood, launched this year
HMS Hood sunk in the Denmark Strait with about 1,400 lost
Recovered from the wreck at a depth of nearly 3 km
Rededicated in Portsmouth, 75 years after the sinking

tiers.everyday: This ship's bell was raised from the wreck of HMS Hood, sunk in 1941, nearly 3 km down. It is now a memorial in Portsmouth.
tiers.student: The Royal Navy recovered the bell in 2015 and rededicated it on 24 May 2016. The museum notes it first served in an earlier battleship Hood launched in 1891, so it outlived three ships of the name.
